Hernals (17. Bezirk) — Vienna, Austria

Relatively safer day Relatively safer night

In detail

No press reports of violent street crime, drug-dealing hotspots or tourist-targeted crime were found for Hernals. The one recurring theme in local press is property crime affecting residents' cars and bicycles: meinbezirk.at's review of 2024 police statistics found bike thefts up from 144 to 181 cases, car break-ins up from 61 to 87, and damage to parked cars up from 172 to 215, alongside 3 homicides and 11 sexual assaults recorded district-wide for the year — figures that are largely about residential/vehicle property crime rather than incidents affecting pedestrians or visitors. Hernals is also described in local media as an up-and-coming ('Trendbezirk') residential area. On balance, honest press research turned up nothing indicating a particular safety concern for a traveller on foot, day or night. Sources checked: meinbezirk.at, "Kriminaljahr 2024: Autos in Hernals besonders oft Ziel von Verbrechern" (13 May 2025); wien.gv.at, Bezirk Hernals Sicherheit page.
